question: When Mars sits in the 4th or 7th from the Lagna in Mesham, Viruchigam or Magaram, is this Ruchaka, Sevvai, or both? Please mark each chart.
ruling: DOCTRINE_DECISIONS_V1.md §18, Q7. Until ruled, O-18 governs: both shown at full weight.
